Remote
Professional Summary
Experienced cloud and DevOps engineer with a strong background in Azure platform automation, infrastructure as code, and production-grade ML model deployment. Proven track record designing CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure provisioning, and collaborating with product teams to deliver measurable improvements in reliability and deployment velocity. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, PowerShell, Bicep, Python, Machine Learning, Jira

Work Experience
Senior Azure DevOps Engineer, Vertex Analytics (May 2022 - Present)
- Led implementation of Azure DevOps pipelines for microservice deployments, using Azure DevOps and Bicep to standardize environments and reduce deployment failures by 40%.
- Automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and Bicep for AKS clusters and supporting services; integrated PowerShell scripts to manage resource lifecycles and streamline on-call remediation.
- Collaborated with data science teams to containerize ML workloads and deploy to Kubernetes, enabling reproducible model deployment workflows tracked via Azure DevOps and Jira.

Cloud Engineer, Bluefin Logistics (Oct 2018 - Apr 2022)
- Designed and implemented Terraform-based landing zones on Azure to support multi-environment deployments, improving environment provisioning time from days to hours.
- Built CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for containerized applications running on Kubernetes, introducing automated canary rollouts and rollback mechanisms to reduce downtime.
- Wrote PowerShell and Python automation to manage Azure resources and operational runbooks; coordinated releases and tracked work in Jira.

Machine Learning Engineer, Zentrix Labs (May 2016 - Sep 2018)
- Developed end-to-end machine learning models in Python, implementing preprocessing, training, and evaluation pipelines to improve prediction accuracy for client projects.
- Containerized ML inference services and worked with engineering to deploy models into Kubernetes environments, enabling scalable serving integrated with Azure CI/CD using Azure DevOps.
- Documented experiments and collaborated via Jira to track model performance, versioning, and deployment tasks.

Education
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
